_about: Chassis. Not classes: any silhouette, any component in any slot. Numbers are in tens. hardpoints is the die size. loadout is the default components; if their faces total fewer than hardpoints, filler fills the rest. passive is zero or one object; its rules list is one idea with up to three lines (an upside and its cost count as one passive). Passives run through sim/passives.gd; the validator refuses effects the engine cannot execute. Player-facing text: codex, flavour (an in-world line, shown as a quote) and a passive's description (the codex prints NAME: description rules). fantasy is internal: the pitch, the inspiration, any homage; it is never shown. Makers are placeholders.

makers.name: Halvard Heavy Works
makers.style: Armour first. Everything is a tank, even the ones with legs.
makers.voice: Maintenance manual. Terse, exact, proud of tolerances.

makers.name: Kestrel Dynamics
makers.style: Fast, fragile, over-tuned. Airframes and interceptors.

makers.name: Orrin & Pike
makers.style: Quads and artillery. Old firm, odd designs, everything works.

entries.name: Bulwark
entries.fantasy: A tank with fists. It goes where it is pointed and things stop being there.
entries.codex: Halvard's answer to everything: armour, then more armour, then fists. Slow, hard to kill, and it never throws a weak punch.

passive.name: Braced Mounts
passive.description: Halvard does not build guns that whiff.

entries.flavour: Halvard pattern seven. Hull rated for sustained contact. The crews call it the door.

entries.name: Sentinel
entries.fantasy: Four legs, six hardpoints, no strong opinions. The one you build around.
entries.codex: The Orrin & Pike general-purpose walker. Six hardpoints and no opinions about what goes in them; whatever the squad is missing, this is where it gets bolted on.
entries.flavour: Orrin & Pike walker frame. Six hardpoints, no favourites. The one that comes back.

entries.name: Raptor
entries.fantasy: A priority-target assassin. Hit, run, and let someone else carry the fire extinguisher.
entries.codex: Kestrel's interceptor. Hits twice as hard as anything its size and runs twice as hot doing it. Somebody else carries the fire extinguisher.

passive.name: Hot Hands
passive.description: Everything it fires, it fires too hard.

entries.flavour: Kestrel interceptor airframe. Reactor governor removed by field order. Run it hot and trust the housing.

entries.name: Anvil
entries.fantasy: Sits at the back of the fight and ruins the back of theirs.
entries.codex: Orrin & Pike's fire-support walker. Reaches their back rank from ours, and what it sets alight stays alight.

passive.name: Hot Load
passive.description: When an Orrin & Pike shell lands right, it keeps burning.
rules: Critical hits add one burn stack to the target.

entries.flavour: Orrin & Pike fire-support walker. Sits behind the line and unmakes the far side of the fight.
